turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's zero was entered before anyone called me.
Thanks for coming in. I should have called before the zero went in. That was wrong.
Okay. Then take it off.
Were you home the night of October 28?
I'm not the one being questioned. Why was the zero entered before anyone called me?
I'm asking because it matters. Were you home?
Answer mine first. Who decided on the zero, and on what basis?
Did you see Owen working on the essay that night?
I'm not a witness here. What do you have on the essay?
You're not answering. Why not?
Because that's your job, not mine. Show me what you have.
Is there something about that night you don't want to tell me?
Are you calling me a liar? My son's essay is the subject of this meeting, and you've shown me nothing.
If he wrote it, you'd just say so. Did you see him write it?
That's a question built to trap me, and I've been on the other side of it for twenty years. Withdraw the zero, or show me a document.
I'll ask one more time. What did you see that night?

Same answer. I'm not here to be cross-examined about my house.

You've asked four times. Now I'll ask: what do you have on the essay itself?
Okay. Then let me show you the version history. Created 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting.
I'm writing that down. Did you have it when you entered the zero? Because procedure 4.2 says someone calls me first, and nobody did.
So, again: was he on his own computer that night?
He's been up late for weeks, and that isn't evidence of anything. I'm not answering questions about my house. Did you have that history when you entered the zero, yes or no?
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed in our meeting today. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that his record stays clean; that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out first.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling her in one plain sentence, and that earned a flat okay, because it answered her first complaint without excuses.
What cost ground: You asked what she saw at home again and again, and it hardened her and used up your time, because she will never be a witness for you.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your questions about that night and the late-night times in the version history came close to it, but that proves nothing about the essay, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after owning the mistake, put the version history in front of her with its date so she can check it, then offer the supervised rewrite in writing instead of questioning her about her house.
